notes: The repository is one tracked file of 63 lines, added in a single commit in April 2019. Every line was read. Two artifacts rather than three: locId and GET_DETAILS are one concept (Places lookup as a spreadsheet formula pair) and are recorded together; writeDataToFirebase is an unrelated second idea sharing the file. No patterns — nothing here spans more than one implementation. No review candidates — small as it is, a Places-in-Sheets snippet and a Sheets-to-RTDB export are both clear answers to a 'have I done this before?' question, so neither was ambiguous. No config.json is present, so source.config_sha is null and every default applies.
